address: Yeniköy Mahallesi, Köybaşı Caddesi No:71, Sarıyer, Istanbul, 34464, Türkiye
bio: As you make your way through this chic restaurant, you will certainly be drawn to the modern works of art and the panoramic view of the Bosporus. But what really catches the eye at AZUR is the seafood on display. The quality is second to none! All that excellent produce is showcased in dishes that fluidly blend Turkish and Mediterranean culinary traditions. Think Atlantic bluefin tuna tartare with creamy stracciatella, super-fresh fish on the plancha, paella or pasta. Meat fans are also well catered for. The servers will be happy to give you a few pointers to help you get the most out of this culinary adventure.
